pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with softened, curvilinear edges showing low pixel-level angularity. Patch area is larger and more irregular on the upper rump, transitioning to smaller, more uniform diamond-like geometries on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting light-colored pathways of consistent pixel thickness. Junction nodes are primarily trilateral, forming a continuous topological lattice. Continuity is partially obscured by foreground vegetation in the central frame.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive foreground occlusion by green foliage and woody stems bisecting the mid-lateral and lower-neck sections of the subject.
